about.title: About
about.text: Hello! My name is Paulo Henrique, I'm 21 years old, and I'm a Full Stack Developer with a technical degree in Web Development from SENAC Lapa Tito. I also completed the PROPROFISSÃO - Web Development with Python program at Instituto PROA, focused on preparing young people for the job market. I'm currently pursuing a technical degree in Artificial Intelligence and have developed projects using technologies such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Node.js, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. I also have experience working as a Scrum Master and Full Stack Developer on the DunDum project, combining technical development with team organization. In addition, I'm expanding my knowledge of Robotic Process Automation (RPA) using UiPath. My main goal is to continue growing in the technology field, seeking new challenges and opportunities to contribute, learn, and develop professionally. Want to see my work?
